prior_findings.evidence: Security/high. Old code rejected the real disjoint 33god-pm route via project_root.is_relative_to(profile_home) (red.log: ContractorTurnRejected 'outside the authorized profile boundary' at then-run.py:21302). Fix: containment check removed; profile_home and project_root are now independently strict-resolved and dir-checked (run.py:21294-21315) with registry authorization owned by Bloodbank per the typed-context contract (base.py:2515-2520). Live registry confirms the disjoint route (project_path=/home/delorenj/code/33GOD; profile ~/.hermes/profiles/33god-pm). Passing tests: test_contractor_turn_accepts_disjoint_typed_project_root plus revalidation and untrusted-context rejection tests (42/42 fresh).

Concurrency/high. c61c871 treated explicit null service_tier as omission, falling back to shared runner state (red.log: contractor_route unexpectedly inherited 'priority'). Fix: SERVICE_TIER_UNSET sentinel default (run.py:9060) with fallback only on omission (run.py:9114-9115); explicit None stays normal-tier. Passing test: test_null_contractor_service_tier_is_distinct_from_ordinary_omission (fresh run), plus the two shared-state/concurrency tests proving runner attributes are never written by contractor turns.

Error-handling/high. c61c871 put cleanup_error into the worker result but _handle_contractor_turn discarded it, so platform completion recorded SUCCESS (red.log: on_processing_complete awaited with SUCCESS; handler DID NOT RAISE). Fix: successful result with cleanup_error raises ContractorTurnCleanupFailed (run.py:21412-21416); failed result re-raises ContractorTurnRejected with the cleanup note attached (run.py:21404-21411); primary in-flight exceptions get the note via add_note in the worker finally (run.py:21257-21262); platform observes FAILURE (base.py:7315-7316). Passing tests: test_cleanup_failure_raises_from_public_contractor_handler, test_cleanup_failure_marks_platform_processing_failed, test_contractor_cleanup_failure_is_observed_on_successful_turn, test_contractor_cleanup_failure_is_observed_on_failed_turn (42/42 fresh).
